title: Kryptr deploy manifest entry (wave-5 Q3 baseline)
description: One file per deployment at contracts/deployments/{chain}.json. The vault factory allowlist binds each factory to its T21 verification artifact via verificationId — missing verificationId means no allowlist entry and the factory stays dark (fail-closed).

chain.description: Chain identifier, e.g. 'base' (chainId may be embedded in CI checks later).

verificationId.description: Explorer verification artifact id binding factory → verified source (T21). REQUIRED — fail-closed without it.

verificationHash.description: Optional verification source hash (extra binding strength).

salt.description: Deterministic CREATE2 salt (derived from token params + version, never random).

commitSha.description: Commit sha the deployed bytecode was built from.
